}} '''Vaal Arctic Armour''' is a [[vaal skill|Vaal]] [[spell]] that encases you in ice, [[freeze|freezing]] you and preventing any active movement or action, but granting you a massive reduction to damage taken from hits for a duration or until you take a certain number of damaging hits, as well as regenerating [[mana]] and [[energy shield]] during the effect. ==Skill functions and interactions== You count as {{stl|Frozen}} while encased in ice, even if the player is Immune to or Unaffected by Freeze. This can enable certain self-freeze mechanics, such as {{il|Winterheart}}. You cannot directly move or perform non-[[instant]] actions while encased in ice regardless of [[ailment defences]] against Freeze, including entering through a [[portal]]. This cannot be bypassed. Triggered skills and {{il|Frostblink}} are still usable to move around. Vaal Arctic Armour's mana and energy shield regeneration counts as a buff and is affected by {{il|Ichimonji}} and {{c|mod|Arctic Armour has #% increased Buff Effect}} from [[Eldritch implicit modifier]]s and {{il|The Snowblind Grace}}. The encased in ice and less damage taken stats are considered a skill [[effect]] rather than a buff, and therefore cannot be scaled further by buff effect. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Mana
